## What changes and why

<!-- One logical change. Say why, not only what. -->

## Gates run locally, each on its own exit code

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `bash scripts/ai-tone-gate.sh`

## If this touches a property, a verdict or a number

- [ ] The statute text or the primary source is cited in the change.
- [ ] A corpus object under `corpus/ncco/` shows the verdict and the witness path.
- [ ] No surface claims something the code does not do.
